captured_turns.narration:
You look around the tavern carefully.

Aulus, Bassus, and Cato all scan the room with practiced eyes, noting the patrons and exits. Aulus rests his hand on his sword hilt. Cato keeps an ear toward the other guards' conversation.

npc_turns.action: Scans the room with a practiced eye, hand resting on my sword hilt, noting the patrons and exits.
Scan the room with a practiced eye, noting exits and any patrons who look too restless.
Scan the room with a practiced eye, noting the patrons and exits while keeping an ear toward the other guards' conversation.

captured_turns.narration:
You attempt to punch Aulus in the face. He ducks under your swing, grabs your wrist, and slams you hard against the wall. An armored forearm presses against your throat.

Aulus snarls, "You just earned yourself a night in the cells, fool."

Bassus draws his short sword and moves to flank you, the blade leveled at your side. He says, "Drop to your knees, hands behind your head—now!"

Cato unsheathes his short sword and steps forward, placing the point against your lower back. He grips your shoulder with his free hand.
